answers.description: An AI-powered tool that analyzes and optimizes resumes for job applications
answers.problem_statement: This app helps job seekers tailor their resumes to specific job descriptions, instantly shows ATS compatibility with keyword-gap analysis, and provides concrete feedback on what to improve before applying.
answers.target_users: Job seekers actively applying for roles
answers.voice_tone: Concise and honest — factual, no hype, matches the grounded ethos of the product
answers.frontend: Next.js — minimal UI, functionality-first, no design polish required
answers.infrastructure: Local — run on own device, no cloud deployment, simple startup script
answers.tdd: Flexible — tests recommended for complex logic only (e.g. validation, ATS scoring)
design_principles: Truthfulness over impressiveness — Never fabricate skills or metrics. Every generated resume is validated against your profile; suggestions are checked before applying.
Simplicity over features — One profile, per-job mini-projects with clear analysis + chat + versioning. No complexity; every feature directly serves tailoring or transparency.
Transparency — Show exactly what keywords match/gap, what changed in each resume version, why a suggestion was rejected (if it fabricates), and the full version history so nothing disappears.
key_goals: Enable honest, grounded resume tailoring — Let job seekers tailor resumes to specific job descriptions by reordering, potentially adding, emphasizing, and omitting profile content—but never fabricating. Every generated resume is validated to ensure it stays truthful.

Provide visibility into job fit and ATS compatibility — Show candidates upfront what keywords/skills from the JD match their profile, what gaps exist, and how well their tailored resume will parse in applicant tracking systems before they hit apply.

Maintain a single authoritative profile with clean versioning — Eliminate resume file fragmentation. Manage one profile once, generate unlimited job-specific tailored versions, and preserve full version history so nothing is ever lost.
